method: Read the full original draft and opposite-language candidate for each rendered candidate instance. Assess scope, negation, boundaries, conditions, fee order and unresolved ambiguity. Exact string comparisons and hashes bind this assessment to these artifacts but do not themselves establish translation quality.
scopeLimitations: This is an AI review, not a human bilingual audit.
These finite policy samples do not establish general model translation fidelity.
Repeated or reused translation instances are included in the rendered-instance count, not represented as new independent translations.
Mosaic AST correctness relies on the separate parent runner; this audit independently checks its full prose translations.

nonBlockingPresentationFindings.finding: Both executable candidates use the short label Students submitted strictly before 2027-04-09 for the early-student rule. That label omits T16:00:00.000Z and could be read as an earlier midnight cutoff when displayed alone. Full translated policy prose, time predicates, and detailed trace preserve the correct instant.
nonBlockingPresentationFindings.recommendation: Use a neutral Early student rate label or include the complete cutoff instant; do not shorten a timestamp inside a temporal claim.

nonBlockingPresentationFindings.finding: Spanish feeReason appends the English rule label (for example Members or Students submitted strictly before 2027-04-09). This is mixed-language presentation, without changing admission or price.
nonBlockingPresentationFindings.recommendation: Localize fee labels if the explanation is intended to be fully Spanish.
